notes: Corrected: t011 on was assigned to πρός. πρός governs the articular infinitive τὸ ἐπιθυμῆσαι and is realized by the clause-introducing to at t014 under rule 61; on governs a woman, the accusative object of βλέπων, and belongs to that participle as the English verb's own particle. The accepted reading also crossed the alignment, placing a word before a woman on a token standing after it.
The two supplied English prepositions in the verse now read alike: on with βλέπων and after with ἐπιθυμῆσαι, neither answering to any expressed Greek preposition.
The notes on the βλέπων and πρός units were left unfinished in the accepted file and are rewritten; the substantive alternatives are recorded on the units themselves.
